title: Baat bi ci suuf yu yàgg yi
intro: Ci ndawi Yàlla yu njëkk ya, amoon na kenn ku turam feeñ ci Al Quran ci lu gàtt waaye am lu muy tekki. Nit kooku mingi dundu bu yàgg balaa ñuy yónnee yonent yu mag yu bari, ñu xamee ko ci dëggu ak muñ gu mat sëkk. Seen jaar-jaar gàtt na waaye seen erf du yàgg ba fàww. Kan mooy ruuh bu baax bii?
clues: Man maay kenn ci ndaw yi njëkka am, ñu wax ci Al Quran ci lu gàtt waaye ci anam wu am solo.
Li gënoon fës ci sama jikko mooy gëm dëgg te baña xàddi.
Maa ngi fàttaliku ci téeré Yàlla ci ña doon takku tey muñ.
Ay aaya yu gàtt yu néew ci Al Quran ñoo nettali sama jaar-jaar.
Allah daf ma sargal ci anam wu amul benn yoon buma bokkul ak yeneen yonent yi.
Dañu ma yar ci rang bu kawe, muy xeetu ngor bu amul fenn ci Al Quran.

trial.label: Moment buy màndargaal
options: Yallah ma yékkati ci barab bu kawe
Dama tabax gaal gu mag ngir muccal sama askan
Samay rak ñoo ma sànni ci benn pax
Dama ñàkk samay bët ndax naqar sama doom
trial.answer: Yallah ma yékkati ci barab bu kawe

outcome.label: ngor Yàlla
options: Gaaraas bu kawe bu wuute ak yeneen yi
Nguuru jinne yi ak ngelaw yi
outcome.answer: Gaaraas bu kawe bu wuute ak yeneen yi

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
